remarks: Turnkey 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath condo in the highly desirable Glenrock community in Norwalk's coveted Silvermine area, where condos rarely come to market. This serene and spacious residence has been extensively renovated, including an updated kitchen and beautifully remodeled bathrooms. The open-concept living and dining area features sliding doors to a balcony overlooking lush gardens, as well as a wood-burning fireplace. The primary suite offers an ensuite bath, bay window, and vaulted ceiling. The second bedroom also features an ensuite bathroom. Additional highlights include an upper-level laundry area, attached one-car garage, and large private storage unit. Set on beautifully maintained, heavily landscaped grounds, Glenrock offers a swimming pool, is pet-friendly, and provides a peaceful retreat with exceptional convenience. Enjoy a short stroll to the Merritt 7 Metro-North station for an easy commute to Grand Central, plus close proximity to Calf Pasture Beach, excellent restaurants, and golf.
